title: Read The Rules
description: Gives a Editable Config for Rules and A Command for Accepting Rules!
body:
# Read The Rules

Read The Rules is a simple mod made to ensure every player understands and follows your server rules from the moment they join.

## Features
- Fully customizable server rules.
- Color code support for formatted messages.
- Config hot-reloading support.

## Commands

### `/rules`
Sends the configured server rules in chat.

### `/rules accept`
Accept the server rules.

### `/rules reload`
Reloads the config without restarting the server.

## Configuration

All rules can be customized directly inside the config file.

Supports Minecraft-style color codes for better formatting and emphasis.
